answer: A Weekly community check-in streak over two seasons verified by on-chain log entries makes identity a record of showing up: every week the applicant signs in, the on-chain log entries go on the public record, and one missed week resets the streak to zero, so the network trusts the account that was there every week, not the one that appeared yesterday. Without this check, a signal of fresh fake accounts could appear overnight. A wharf and a nebula may look alike, but only the identity with an unbroken record is honoured.
